Definition: Cancellation, refund amount, cancellation policy, bad-weather refund
Default source of truth: Booking state + cancellation policy + refund quote API + disruption events
Default action: Quote refund; require confirmation before cancellation
Escalation trigger: Dispute, post-experience complaint, no quote, ambiguous weather cause

Definition: Ticket, voucher, confirmation email, QR code
Default action: Resend or display approved ticket info
Escalation trigger: Voucher missing close to departure or auth failure

Definition: Meeting point, pickup time, pickup location, arrival instructions
Default source of truth: Booking record + product logistics fields + supplier notes
Escalation trigger: Conflicting/missing pickup details near start time

Definition: Change date/time/traveler count/pickup/traveler details
Default source of truth: Booking rules + live availability + pricing API
Default action: Offer eligible options and price delta
Escalation trigger: Supplier approval required, unavailable inventory, policy conflict

Definition: Child, infant, senior, student, or accessibility eligibility
Escalation trigger: Text conflicts with structured rule or customer wants bypass

Definition: What is included, excluded, multi-pass validity, equipment, food, transport
Default source of truth: Structured option fields + product inclusions/exclusions + supplier notes
Escalation trigger: Post-purchase mismatch/dispute

Definition: Access to account, email change, unauthorized request
Default action: Verify identity before disclosing or changing
Escalation trigger: Third-party request or suspicious behavior

Definition: Missed tour, no-show dispute, operator issue, service quality complaint
Default action: Create case; do not promise compensation
Escalation trigger: Refund demand, safety issue, evidence conflict

Definition: Wheelchair, mobility, service animal, special assistance
Default action: Answer carefully and offer operator confirmation
Escalation trigger: Ambiguous accessibility or safety-critical accommodation

Definition: Medical, safety, lost traveler, immediate operational issue
Default source of truth: Booking + operator contact + emergency support SOP
Default action: Provide safe next steps and escalate
Escalation trigger: Any urgent safety situation

Definition: Payment, billing, duplicate charge, refund-to-card, or amount/currency dispute
Default source of truth: Payment/transaction records + booking state + billing policy
Default action: Verify the charge against transaction records; explain or open a billing case; never move money automatically
Escalation trigger: Confirmed duplicate or incorrect charge, chargeback, or fraud signal

Definition: Lookup or explanation; no money/change/security risk
Escalation trigger: Critical always escalates or blocks unsafe action

Definition: Could affect trip outcome or eligibility
Escalation trigger: Critical always escalates or blocks unsafe action

Definition: Money, booking modification, dispute, or customer harm risk
Escalation trigger: Critical always escalates or blocks unsafe action

Definition: Security/privacy breach, fraud, threat, safety incident
Escalation trigger: Critical always escalates or blocks unsafe action
